name: How long does stucco repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stucco repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage. Small patches or crack repairs might take a few hours to a day. More extensive repairs involving larger sections, multiple layers, or addressing underlying water damage can take several days to over a week, including drying and curing times for each layer. Weather conditions can also influence the timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco repair can take a few hours for small patches, or several days to over a week for extensive damage.
